chapter_title_en: The Offshore Hunt Begins: Soul Extraction and Core Harvesting
chapter_seo_title: The Offshore Hunt Begins: Han Li's First Grade-Six Demon Beast Kill
chapter_meta_description: Han Li takes his solo hunting to the open sea, setting up a Rainbow Garment Grass lure to systematically harvest grade-six demon beast inner cores.
og_title: Chapter 531 - The Offshore Hunt Begins: Soul Extraction and Core Harvesting
og_description: Han Li embarks on a methodical, lone hunting campaign in the deep sea, using a Rainbow Garment Grass lure and carefully prepared formations to trap and kill grade-six demon beasts for their inner cores.
twitter_description: Han Li's solo farming arc: lure, trap, kill, repeat. Grade-six inner cores incoming.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare wood that passively strengthens and protects the cultivator's soul when worn against the skin; no refinement is needed for its basic effect.
A rare lure-herb that attracts demon beasts by releasing a concentrated, enticing aura at specific stages of growth; used by cultivators to set up hunting traps.
The emerald fluid produced by the Heaven Vial; can accelerate the growth of spirit plants and wood, but has no effect once the material reaches its natural growth limit.
A set of flying swords refined from the Azure Bamboo Forest's rare material; Han Li's signature magical weapon at this stage.
An ancient treasure that can bind a target with five colored rings, fully immobilizing it for a brief period.
A black ritual vessel used to extract and capture the soul of a freshly killed demon beast, preventing it from dissipating or escaping.
A condensed sphere of spiritual energy formed inside a demon beast's body; its quality and size increase with the beast's grade, and it is used in alchemy and crafting.
A demon beast whose power is roughly equivalent to a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator; its inner core is semi-translucent and valuable for advanced refinement.
